# Mac app — Window

## Main window

![Main window](data:image/webp;base64,)

### MainWindow.swift
- WINDOW CHROME IS DARK IN BOTH APPEARANCES: background Tok.chrome #0c0d0f, sidebar forced .dark colorScheme; pane follows system (white in light).
- Pane: bg, concentric radius (min 8) w/ window corners, 1pt paneEdge stroke clipped (0.5 inner hairline), shadow .05 r1 y1; inset 8 trailing+bottom (leading 8 if sidebar hidden); toolbar transparent above
- Toolbar (navigation): sidebar.left toggle, chevronLeft back, chevronRight forward (icon 15) all icon-button 28; thread route adds 'Open in New Window' (macwindow.badge.plus). Status placement: ReconnectingLabel (running glyph 6 + 12 fg3)
- UpdateBar at top of pane; BannerStack bottom-trailing overlay
- min window 720x460
- RoutePlaceholder: EmptyNote(symbol,title,message){Go Home pill secondary 32 / route hash 12 mono fg4}

### ThreadWindow.swift
- thread in own window min 480x360, title = thread title; context menu: Open in New Window / Rename Thread... / Move to Folder ▸ / Archive Thread (Unarchive); Rename alert w/ field
- commands: File > Open in New Window ⌥⌘N; Edit > Copy Thread as Markdown ⇧⌘C; View > Show Inspector ⌥⌘I; View > Hide Sidebar ⌃⌘S

- surface r16 line stroke max560 pt8; band 'New thread' 12 medium fg3 pad 16x8 surface2; title 14.5 semibold; prompt 13 fg3 line 3; x 13 icon 26 dismiss; actions: ghost 'Edit' (pencil) | spacer | ghost 'Do it here' | primary 'Start' (28); pad h12 top10 bottom12

## Sidebar

![Sidebar](data:image/webp;base64,)

### SidebarView.swift (dark chrome)
- width 252 (resizable 200–420; handle: 1px lineStrong capsule shows on hover, pad v12)
- top: Wordmark h18 writeOnHover, pl20, h44
- SearchPill: search 15, 'Search or jump to', Kbd ⌘K; 13pt fg4 (hover fg3); pl14 pr8 h40; bg@.7 capsule + cardShadow
- New thread: plus 15 weight 2 + 'New thread' PillButton primary h40 full width; pad h12, gap 8
- Scroll list pad h12 top12 bottom16, section gap 16, row gap 1
- Home (home icon), Conductor (StaticMark 17), groups with caption (pad h12 top4 bottom8), Add channel (plus), Workspace: Artifacts(layers) Automations(zap) Secrets(key)
- selected row: Capsule Tok.thumb (dark: white@.14) + shadow .09 r1 y1 + paneEdge .5 stroke — matched geometry spring
- RailRowStyle: wash capsule scale .72→1 on hover
- NavRow: h32, icon 15 (active fg / fg3), title 13 (medium when active; fg vs fg2), pl12 pr12, gap 10; running badge: glyph 6 + count 11 live
- channel lead: ChannelMark icon 14 or '#' 12 fg4 (fg2 active), w15; hover shows folderPlus 14 button (24) at trailing
- ThreadRow (sidebar): pl 25 offset; status icon w12 (Loader 11 live if running else StatusDot 7); title 12.5 fg3 (active medium fg); HarnessLogo 11 fg4; h28 pad12
- AgentRow: pl43; tree line 1px lineStrong curving r6; desc 12 fg3, Loader 10 live, elapsed 11 fg4 mono digits; pl16 h28
- 'N more' / 'See all threads' 12 fg4 pl32 h28 (+25)
- '… older not shown', 'No threads yet' 12 fg4
- bottom: UsageCard + StatusFooter, gap 10, pad h12 top4 bottom12
- StatusFooter: 7 dot (done w/ edge running, needs notRunning/failed, fg4 else), label fg2 + 'Port 7777' fg4 11pt, chevronDown 12 fg4; Menu
- Context menu channel: Expand/Collapse, New Folder, Channel Settings

### SidebarFolders.swift
- FolderNameField: folder 13 fg3 + field 12.5, h24 surface r8 lineStrong stroke; row h28 pl12 pr6
- FolderRowView: chevronDown/Right 12 fg4, name 12.5 fg2 (hover fg), Loader 11 live if busy, count 11 fg4 (hidden on hover → 'more' 14 fg3 button 24); h28 pl12 pr8; drop target: wash capsule + lineStrong stroke; reorder: 2px fg3 capsule top line
- Folder menu: New Thread Here / Rename / Duplicate / Delete...
- Delete alert: 'Delete "name"?' Delete Folder (destructive) / Cancel
- MoveToFolderMenu submenu

### UsageCard.swift
- collapsed: glyph 6 (done if live), 'Usage' 11 medium fg2, summary 'Claude 2/6 · Codex 0/4' 11 fg3, peak % 10 (needs if bad), chevron 13 fg4
- open: header cols (66 spacer) '5h' 'Week' 11 medium fg4; rows: HarnessLogo 12 + name 12 medium fg2 w66; Meter = 10 ticks gap2 r1.5 used h10 fg (needs if bad) / unused h5.5 fg@.14 + % 10 fg2 w28; 'no data' 10.5 fg4; hairline; summary
- pad 12, bg@.7 r20 + cardShadow

### PaletteView.swift
- scrim #17181a@.22; palette top 60, w620 maxH640, elev bg r28 + menuShadow
- header: search 18 fg4, field 16, Kbd Esc; pl24 pr16 h64; hairline
- group captions pad h16 top12 bottom8; list pad 8
- row h48 pad12 gap12 r16 surface2 when selected; lead 28 (StatusDot, or channel letter disc surface2 11.5 rounded, or icon 14 fg3 in surface2 circle); label 13.5 fg, sub 12 fg4; trailing 11 (live for channels, fg4); arrowRight 14 fg3 when selected
- 'Nothing matches' 13 fg3 py40
- footer: Kbd ↑ ↓ move, Kbd ↵ open; 11.5 fg4 pad 24x10
